mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates tighter monetary policy, which increases discount rates for equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances despite FEDFUNDS being above its historical average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals labor market weakness, which typically reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a contraction in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1400 and RSAFS < 370000.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 200), the Federal Reserve is likely to implement monetary tightening, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 200.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in housing starts below 1400 thousand units signals a slowdown in the housing market, which typically reduces construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1400.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a deteriorating labor market, which reduces household income and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS < 137000 and UNRATE > 4.5.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL < 200), the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative monetary policy, which lowers discount rates and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL < 200.
